scope: Four record-level judgments across two source families, non-exhaustive and not the 37-case matrix

records.basis: Incorrect authorization is broader than revoked authority; DTF-001 is a concrete lifecycle-aware authorization proposition, not equivalent to all CWE-863 instances.
Missing authorization check is distinct from improperly scoped delegated authority; do not claim direct equivalence.
